newsitem.title: HONG KONG: India's CESC debut FRN expected soon.
newsitem.headline: India's CESC debut FRN expected soon.

text.p: Lead manager ANZ Investment Bank expects to launch the debut floating rate note issue for Indian power utility CESC Ltd late next week or early the following week, ANZ said on Friday.
Roadshows for the issue have been held in Tokyo, Taipei and Hong Kong and will be held in Singapore and London.
The US$70 million FRN matures in May 2007 but can be put or called in May 2004. It will be priced to float at between 140 and 160 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.

CESC is the sole distributor of electricity in Calcutta and will maintain that exclusive distribution licence until at least 2020. By government law, the utility receives a mandated rate of return over its costs, the company said.

Proceeds of the note issue will be used to help fund a US$157 million project to expand CESC's network capacity, the company said. CESC projects that electricity demand in its distribution region will grow six percent per annum.

The notes will be listed in Luxembourg and the governing law is English. Financial covenants state that the borrower must maintain minimum asset cover of 1.75 times and minimum interest cover of 1.50 times.
